To kill this mutation would require either: (1) testing internal state changes rather than outputs, (2) testing multi-forward-pass scenarios where corrupted running stats propagate in eval mode, or (3) having num_features such that the OOB write corrupts memory that IS used. rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing for GPU kernels should include internal state verification (checking buffers like running_mean/running_var), not just output comparison. Additionally, boundary-guard mutations in statistics-update kernels require multi-pass testing where training-mode state changes are verified through subsequent inference-mode outputs.
